title: Incremental probe calibration and NDCG streaming pipeline for rerank endpoint
creator: Asha Raman
description: Goal: Build an incremental, low-latency NDCG/MRR streaming pipeline that ties per-request rerank telemetry to customer prompt-set versions and embedding configuration. This ticket covers probe selection + calibration, real-time metric aggregation (NDCG@k, MRR@k), sampling/A-B hooks for live traffic, and a lightweight client-side SDK to tag promptset_version and rerank_config on requests. The result should enable continuous quality tracking across model variants and embedding transforms while keeping end-to-end rerank latency overhead < 8ms p99 for the proxy layer introduced by instrumentation.
acceptance_criteria: Streaming NDCG@5 and MRR@10 metrics emitted to metrics pipeline (prometheus+kafka) with <=30s aggregation window
Per-customer promptset and rerank_config tagging available on each indexed event and exportable to datalake
Probe selection algorithm implemented: hybrid of stratified customer sampling + importance-weighted probe insertion; configurable per-cycle
End-to-end added latency from instrumentation on the rerank proxy < 8ms at p99 under 95th percentile QPS observed in staging
A/B hooks support: traffic fraction control, hash-based consistent bucketing, override via rollout policy in Console
Dashboard in Looker/Metabase showing NDCG/MRR by model variant, promptset_version, and embedding_config with delta and statistical significance markers
design_notes: We trade off probe frequency vs. latency & cost. Initial strategy: target 0.5% of live requests as probe-eligible; for customers with explicit promptsets opt-in at 2%. Probes are soft-inserted into candidate lists and scored offline to compute ground-truth relevance labels. To reduce storage and PII risk, we hash user identifiers and strip free-text payloads for probes before export. For offline eval we keep raw prompts in a secured S3 bucket with KMS encryption and limited IAM roles. For streaming aggregation prefer a schema: {timestamp, customer_id_hash, promptset_version, rerank_config_id, model_variant, candidate_ids, ranks, relevance_signal, probe_flag, latency_ms, token_cost}. We will use a compact protobuf for transport to Kafka to keep message sizes small.
implementation_plan: 1) Add tagging fields to rerank proxy: promptset_version and rerank_config_id (ENG-120345 reference for tagging standard). 2) Implement probe selector service (Go) that subscribes to sampling config via config-service and returns decisions in <1ms. 3) Instrument rerank worker to emit candidate-level rankings and latency into kafka topic rerank-evals. 4) Build a streaming processor (Flink job) to compute incremental NDCG/MRR and push aggregates to metrics pipeline and datalake. 5) Expose A/B control hooks in Console to configure fraction and bucketing for rerank probes and model variants. 6) Add a lightweight client SDK update to node/python SDKs to surface promptset_version and opt-in flags. 7) Run canary with internal customers for 2 weeks before broad rollout.
testing_plan: - Unit tests for probe selector logic with deterministic bucketing - Integration tests: staging deploy with synthetic promptsets and golden relevance labels - Load test: simulate 10K QPS (staging) to measure p99 instrumentation latency - Statistical validation: bootstrap confidence intervals for NDCG/MRR deltas; require p<0.05 for significance on A/B comparisons - Privacy tests: verify payload redaction and encryption flows
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Feature flags off. Phase 1: Internal beta (eng+se) with 0.5% probe rate, monitor latency and metric correctness for 7 days. Phase 2: Pilot 3 customer accounts who opt-in to promptset tracking at 2% probe rate. Phase 3: Gradual ramp to 0.5% global baseline, enable A/B hooks in Console for controlled experiments. Rollback strategy: if p99 latency grows >3ms over baseline or NDCG delta shows regression >2% across customers, flip feature flag and pause probes.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Probe insertion could skew production ranking cache hit rates. Mitigation: Use a separate probe-only cache path and mark probe queries to avoid polluting live caches. Risk: Message volume could spike datalake storage cost. Mitigation: Compact protobuf schema, 30-day hot retention then archive. Risk: Statistical noise for low-volume customers. Mitigation: apply hierarchical smoothing and report cohort-level metrics by default.
